name: light-note-miniprogram
description: 轻记微信原生小程序项目骨架

scripts.typecheck: npm run configure:env && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 && tsc -p cloudfunctions/user/tsconfig.json --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 && tsc -p cloudfunctions/ledger/tsconfig.json --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0
scripts.test: npm run configure:env && tsx --test tests/money.test.ts tests/date.test.ts tests/error.test.ts tests/project-structure.test.ts tests/user-initialization.test.ts tests/cloudbase-deployment-contract.test.ts tests/transaction-form.test.ts tests/transaction-list.test.ts tests/ledger-service.test.ts tests/ledger-function.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build:cloudfunctions
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build:cloudfunctions
